concerns.text: The plan matches users across Reddit Loneliness and Pushshift datasets by hashing usernames. This assumes identical usernames on both platforms; any discrepancy will produce mismatches, introducing measurement error and selection bias that is not addressed.

The mixed‑effects model includes lagged usage predictors but does not control for prior loneliness scores (i.e., the baseline level of the outcome). Without adjusting for the previous loneliness measurement, the model conflates change with level, threatening causal interpretation of the lagged effect.

Attachment style is proxied using the ECAR lexicon, yet the plan provides no evidence that ECAR reliably measures attachment anxiety/avoidance. Using an unvalidated proxy jeopardizes construct validity of the key control variable.

concerns.location: plan.md:# Phase 2 – Baseline Model & Power Check
concerns.text: Power considerations are reduced to a heuristic match‑rate ≥ 80 % and a minimum sample size of 500. No formal a priori power analysis (e.g., simulation for mixed‑effects with random slopes) is presented, so the study may be under‑powered to detect realistic effect sizes.

A subgroup analysis for users aged ≥ 60 is planned without any power assessment for this smaller stratum. Given typical attrition, the subgroup may lack sufficient observations, leading to unreliable age‑moderation conclusions.

The set of covariates (age, gender, attachment scores) omits other plausible confounders such as baseline mental‑health status, socioeconomic indicators, or prior AI‑companion exposure, which could bias the estimated association between usage and loneliness.
